# Embeddings Provider Interface

This module provides a thin interface for embedding text representations from different providers. It supports selection of OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, and a deterministic fake embedder (for testing and offline usage) via explicit configuration, mirroring the provider selection pattern. The interface allows embedding of texts into vectors for downstream tasks such as retrieval.
